entries.左键单选并拖动：音块模式移动音块（水平改拍位、竖直改音高，块内 Pitch 节点: Left click selects and drags: in note mode the note moves (horizontal changes the beat, vertical the pitch, and its pitch points follow); in pitch-line mode points can only be dragged vertically (beat locked). Drag on empty space with the left button to box-select notes and visible points, then drag any selected note to move the whole selection; press Del/BackSpace to delete it. Right click adds a note or point at the pointer according to the current mode (clicking a note edge turns an anchor into a control point); every note starts with 5 owned points, and the first and last are edge anchors that are hidden and cannot be dragged. The pitch line is a uniform cubic B-spline. Notes never create new overlaps: dragging left is limited by the previous note's end, and when dragging right past the next note, that note and all following ones shift while keeping their spacing; overlaps are adjusted only by the transition point inside them. Each segment's crossfade length (in beats) is set from the Segments panel on the right: dashed lines extend from the previous note's end and from the next note's start, and the vertical handle at each end can be dragged left/right to change the length (0-4 beats), with the slider kept in sync. Shortcuts: Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+O open, Del/BackSpace delete the selection. Every track has its own library, segments and synthesis parameters; rendering and playback apply to the current tab only. Output folder: _output/ui.
